findings.suggested_fix: Replace “makanisa mengi makubwa” with “makanisa mengi ya kawaida” or another rendering conveying mainstream churches, not large churches.

findings.location: Paragraph on Abraham and the covenant ratification (after Genesis 15:17)
findings.source_quote: “Abraham ever questioned or doubted the promise of God”
findings.suggested_fix: Change “kutilia maanani ahadi ya Mungu” to “kutilia shaka ahadi ya Mungu” so both verbs convey questioning or doubting the promise.
findings.translation_quote: “Abrahamu aliwahi kutilia shaka au kutilia maanani ahadi ya Mungu”

findings.source_quote: “Every good gift and every perfect gift”
findings.suggested_fix: Use “Kila kipawa chema na kila kipawa kikamilifu” (or another natural rendering of “gift”) instead of “tuzo” for the second gift.
findings.translation_quote: “Kila kipawa chema na kila tuzo kamilifu”
